spans.s: Peṭakapāla (EI 28, 29), keeper of the boxes containing records; record-keeper; same as Peṭāpāla, etc.
Peṭapāla (EI 30; BL), keeper of boxes containing official records; the record-keeper.
Peṭāpāla (EI 29), also called Peṭakapāla; record-keeper; same as Peṭapāla.
Peṭṭapāla (EI 15, 28), keeper of the record-boxes; same as Peṭāpāla, Peṭakapāla, Peḍāpāla, etc.
Peṭavika (EI 30), a class of officials; Peṭavika-vārika (IE 8-8).
